title: A Sylvester-Type Matrix Equation over the Dual Quaternion Algebra with an Application
content: The Sylvester-type equation has applications in many fields, such as control theory, scientific computing, and signal processing. However, research on the Sylvester-type equation over dual quaternions remains limited. In this paper, using generalized inverses and matrix rank , we provide necessary and sufficient conditions for the solvability of the dual quaternion matrix equation AX+BYC+ZD=E. When the solvability conditions are satisfied, the general expression of the solution is derived. Subsequently, a numerical example is presented to verify the obtained results. Finally, based on these results, an application in color image encryption and decryption is provided.
